title: Start a CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format
summary: Create CHANGELOG.md at the repo root in Keep a Changelog format, with an empty Unreleased section and a 0.1.0 section summarizing the initial contents. No tooling or other files change.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered format and version from Cargo.toml and docs/design/athena-v0.md, which sketches a CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog form.
One new file, with an optional README link.
Entries are written for an outside reader.

assumptions: Format is Keep a Changelog with Semantic Versioning, as the design doc example suggests.
Workspace version is 0.1.0, so the first released section is 0.1.0, with an empty Unreleased section above it.
No automated changelog tooling is added; this is a hand-written file.

acceptance_criteria.text: CHANGELOG.md exists at the repository root in Keep a Changelog form, with an Unreleased section and a 0.1.0 section.
The 0.1.0 entries summarize what the repository contains, drawn from README.md, BRIEF.md and docs/architecture.md, with no invented features.
CHANGELOG.md contains no secrets or personal data, and no governance files are changed.
Run git status and git diff: only CHANGELOG.md (and optionally README.md) changed. Run cargo fmt --check and cargo test: both still pass.

out_of_scope: Release tooling, tags, or automated changelog generation
